$log = 'C:\Windows\Setup\Scripts\DefaultUser.log' function Log { param($m) "$(Get-Date -f 'HH:mm:ss') $m" | Out-File $log -Append -Encoding UTF8 } Log '=== DefaultUser.ps1 iniciado ==='
# Copilot: desabilitado para novos usuarios reg.exe add "HKU\DefaultUser\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsCopilot" /v TurnOffWindowsCopilot /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f 2>&1 | Out-Null
# OneDrive: remover do startup de novos usuarios Remove-ItemProperty -LiteralPath 'Registry::HKU\DefaultUser\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run' -Name 'OneDriveSetup' -Force -ErrorAction Continue
# GameDVR: desabilitado reg.exe add "HKU\DefaultUser\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\GameDVR" /v AppCaptureEnabled /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f 2>&1 | Out-Null
# Task View: botao oculto (economiza espaco na barra) reg.exe add "HKU\DefaultUser\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced" /v ShowTaskViewButton /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f 2>&1 | Out-Null
# SmartScreen Edge: desabilitado para novos usuarios reg.exe add "HKU\DefaultUser\Software\Microsoft\Edge\SmartScreenEnabled" /ve /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f 2>&1 | Out-Null reg.exe add "HKU\DefaultUser\Software\Microsoft\Edge\SmartScreenPuaEnabled" /ve /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f 2>&1 | Out-Null reg.exe add "HKU\DefaultUser\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\AppHost" /v EnableWebContentEvaluation /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f 2>&1 | Out-Null reg.exe add "HKU\DefaultUser\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\AppHost" /v PreventOverride /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f 2>&1 | Out-Null
# ContentDeliveryManager: sem apps sugeridos, sem sugestoes, sem anuncios silenciosos $cdm = 'ContentDeliveryAllowed','FeatureManagementEnabled','OEMPreInstalledAppsEnabled','PreInstalledAppsEnabled', 'PreInstalledAppsEverEnabled','SilentInstalledAppsEnabled','SoftLandingEnabled','SubscribedContentEnabled', 'SubscribedContent-310093Enabled','SubscribedContent-338387Enabled','SubscribedContent-338388Enabled', 'SubscribedContent-338389Enabled','SubscribedContent-338393Enabled','SubscribedContent-353694Enabled', 'SubscribedContent-353696Enabled','SubscribedContent-353698Enabled','SystemPaneSuggestionsEnabled' foreach ($n in $cdm) { reg.exe add "HKU\DefaultUser\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\ContentDeliveryManager" /v $n /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f 2>&1 | Out-Null }
# Busca: sem sugestoes Bing na barra de pesquisa reg.exe add "HKU\DefaultUser\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Explorer" /v DisableSearchBoxSuggestions /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f 2>&1 | Out-Null
# DWM: cor de acento sem aplicar na barra de titulo reg.exe add "HKU\DefaultUser\Software\Microsoft\Windows\DWM" /v ColorPrevalence /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f 2>&1 | Out-Null
# Widgets: desabilitados reg.exe add "HKU\DefaultUser\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced" /v TaskbarDa /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f 2>&1 | Out-Null
# Chat Teams: ocultar botao reg.exe add "HKU\DefaultUser\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced" /v TaskbarMn /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f 2>&1 | Out-Null
# Registrar UserOnce.ps1 para executar no primeiro logon de cada usuario reg.exe add "HKU\DefaultUser\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\RunOnce" /v "UnattendUserSetup" /t REG_SZ /d "powershell.exe -WindowStyle Normal -NoProfile -Command \"Get-Content -LiteralPath 'C:\Windows\Setup\Scripts\UserOnce.ps1' -Raw | Invoke-Expression;\"" /f 2>&1 | Out-Null
Log '=== DefaultUser.ps1 concluido ==='

$log = "$env:TEMP\UserOnce.log" function Log { param($m) "$(Get-Date -f 'HH:mm:ss') $m" | Out-File $log -Append -Encoding UTF8 } Log '=== UserOnce.ps1 iniciado ==='
# Copilot provider: remover AppxPackage do usuario Get-AppxPackage -Name 'Microsoft.Windows.Ai.Copilot.Provider' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-AppxPackage -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue Log 'Copilot.Provider removido'
# Menu de contexto classico (sem o menu novo do Win11 com "Mostrar mais opcoes") reg.exe add "HKCU\Software\Classes\CLSID\{86ca1aa0-34aa-4e8b-a509-50c905bae2a2}\InprocServer32" /ve /f 2>&1 | Out-Null Log 'Menu de contexto classico ativado'
# Efeitos visuais: modo customizado Set-ItemProperty -LiteralPath 'Registry::HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\VisualEffects' -Name 'VisualFXSetting' -Type 'DWord' -Value 3 -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue Log 'VisualFXSetting=3 (customizado)'
# Tema: escuro para sistema e apps $themeKey = 'Registry::HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Themes\Personalize' Set-ItemProperty -LiteralPath $themeKey -Name 'SystemUsesLightTheme' -Value 0 -Type DWord -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue Set-ItemProperty -LiteralPath $themeKey -Name 'AppsUseLightTheme' -Value 0 -Type DWord -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue Set-ItemProperty -LiteralPath $themeKey -Name 'ColorPrevalence' -Value 0 -Type DWord -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue Set-ItemProperty -LiteralPath $themeKey -Name 'EnableTransparency' -Value 0 -Type DWord -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue Log 'Tema escuro configurado'
# Papel de parede: cor solida preta (economiza memoria) try { Add-Type -TypeDefinition ' using System; using System.Drawing; using System.Runtime.InteropServices; public class WP { [DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern bool SystemParametersInfo(uint a,uint b,string c,uint d); [DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern bool SetSysColors(int n, int[] e, int[] v); }' -ReferencedAssemblies 'System.Drawing' -ErrorAction Stop [WP]::SystemParametersInfo(20, 0, "", 0) | Out-Null [WP]::SetSysColors(1, @(1), @(0)) | Out-Null Set-ItemProperty 'Registry::HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Wallpapers' -Name 'BackgroundType' -Value 1 -Type DWord -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue Set-ItemProperty 'Registry::HKCU\Control Panel\Desktop' -Name 'WallPaper' -Value '' -Type String -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue Set-ItemProperty 'Registry::HKCU\Control Panel\Colors' -Name 'Background' -Value '0 0 0' -Type String -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue Log 'Papel de parede preto configurado' } catch { Log "Erro ao configurar papel de parede: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
# Cor de acento: azul padrao Windows (#0078D4) try { Add-Type -AssemblyName 'System.Drawing' $accent = [System.Drawing.ColorTranslator]::FromHtml('#0078D4') $dword = [System.BitConverter]::ToUInt32([byte[]]@($accent.R, $accent.G, $accent.B, $accent.A), 0) $accentKey = 'Registry::HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Accent' Set-ItemProperty -LiteralPath $accentKey -Name 'StartColorMenu' -Value $dword -Type DWord -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue Set-ItemProperty -LiteralPath $accentKey -Name 'AccentColorMenu' -Value $dword -Type DWord -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue Set-ItemProperty -LiteralPath 'Registry::HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\DWM' -Name 'AccentColor' -Value $dword -Type DWord -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue Log 'Cor de acento configurada (#0078D4)' } catch { Log "Erro ao configurar cor de acento: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
# Reiniciar Explorer para aplicar configuracoes visuais Start-Sleep -Seconds 2 Get-Process -Name 'explorer' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.SessionId -eq (Get-Process -Id $PID).SessionId } | Stop-Process -Force Log '=== UserOnce.ps1 concluido ==='

$log = 'C:\Windows\Setup\Scripts\FirstLogon.log' function Log { param($m) "$(Get-Date -f 'HH:mm:ss') $m" | Out-File $log -Append -Encoding UTF8 } Log '=== FirstLogon.ps1 iniciado ==='
# Desabilitar auto-logon apos o primeiro logon Set-ItemProperty -LiteralPath 'Registry::HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon' -Name 'AutoLogonCount' -Type 'DWord' -Value 0 -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue Log 'AutoLogon desabilitado para proximos logins'
# DOMINIO: ingresso manual pos-instalacao (nao automatizado) # Para ingressar: abrir PowerShell como admin e executar: # Add-Computer -DomainName "NOME_DO_DOMINIO" -Credential (Get-Credential) -Restart Log 'Ingresso em dominio: manual pos-instalacao'
Log '=== FirstLogon.ps1 concluido ===' Log "Instalacao concluida em: $(Get-Date)" Log "Maquina: $env:COMPUTERNAME" Log "Usuario: $env:USERNAME"
